scope_interpretation.other_broad_indexes_or_major_crypto: May be admitted by the same gates; these four are initial research priorities, not an inferred exhaustive user ban.

classification_rule: A payoff identity at maturity is not guaranteed convergence within 30 minutes. A price inequality is not an executable fill. Statistical convergence is reported separately from locked-payoff arbitrage.

active_candidates.name: Same-expiry micro/nano index-futures parity
active_candidates.hypothesis: Executable cross-size price divergence may exceed all costs and compress before the fixed intraday exit. Matching final SOQ motivates parity but does not prove that horizon.
active_candidates.first_falsification: Test exact same-expiry synchronized books with size for all 10 nanos; reject if fee break-even exceeds executable spread compression, or combined margin/unwind reserve cannot fit.
unresolved: broker margin offsets and minimum account equity
package routing or bounded failed-leg unwind
daily tick rounding and final cash rounding

active_candidates.name: Index-option same-expiry payoff-bound violations
products: SPX as reference or only if unit fits
major-crypto options only after verified specifications/access
active_candidates.hypothesis: An intact executable vertical or butterfly package may violate a verified payoff bound after fees; a separate closing package must realize the edge inside the holding cap.
active_candidates.first_falsification: Use actual package pricing or conservatively executable leg books with matching settlement; reject stale theoretical-mid violations, unaffordable collateral or profits requiring holding beyond the horizon.

active_candidates.name: Prefunded same-asset cross-venue crypto price difference
active_candidates.hypothesis: A funded buy at venue A and equal-unit sell of existing inventory at B may retain positive edge after fees, latency, failure handling and inventory restoration.
active_candidates.first_falsification: Require accessible venues and synchronized depth, $2000 total across cash and coins, and a complete inventory-reset cycle; reject opportunities erased by executable fee tiers or rebalancing.
unresolved: both fee tiers and fee currency

active_candidates.name: Same-venue triangular spot conversion
products: USD to BTC to ETH to USD if all three pairs exist
active_candidates.hypothesis: Three executable directional conversion rates may leave more starting currency after fees, rounding and failed-leg liquidation.
active_candidates.first_falsification: Verify all pairs are simultaneously available to this account and capacity survives the smallest leg; replay actual order-arrival sequencing and full inventory closure.

watchlist.name: Same-index calendar spread
watchlist.promotion_gate: Account margin plus native-spread quotes; a frozen intraday convergence model must survive actual carry, roll, delay and time-stop exits.

watchlist.name: BTC/ETH spot versus eligible derivative intraday basis
watchlist.promotion_gate: Verify actual legal/account access, settlement, margin, funding, borrow, liquidation and hedge sizing. Holding to maturity or through funding cycles is not automatically ultra-short.

watchlist.name: Option synthetic forward versus future
watchlist.promotion_gate: Same underlying scale, expiry instant, settlement index and currency; model discounting/dividends/variation margin. XSP closing settlement and quarterly futures opening SOQ are not interchangeable.

shared_data_and_execution_gates: Freeze exact contracts, economic identity, fee convention, quantities, development/evaluation windows and rejection rules before a performance trial.
Collect bid, ask, size, exchange timestamp, receive timestamp and sequence continuity for every leg. Historical exchange timestamps alone do not establish our receipt latency.

Reject stale or asynchronous apparent crossings, zero/insufficient displayed size, missing intervals and unverified trade-cancellation effects. Never interpolate an executable book from five-minute bars.

Charge entry and exit on every leg, actual fee tier, exchange/clearing costs, financing/funding, inventory reset and total data/infrastructure costs. Do not double-count a spread already embedded in bid/ask fills.
Use integer contracts and actual minimum increments; reserve capital for inventory, collateral, fees, adverse marking and failed-leg unwind. Aggregate capital across venues is at most $2000.
Simulate measured delay, partial/rejected fills and quote withdrawal. Native package support must be verified at both exchange and broker; no independent-leg midpoint fills.
Record every attempted cycle, no-fills, incomplete cycles, timeout unwinds, residual inventory and peak funding. Daily equity marks all assets; a cash receipt is not by itself profit.

Report all-in net P&L, opportunity lifetime, fill probability conditional on latency/size, adverse markout, full-cycle throughput, drawdown and concentration. Fees or delays removing the edge reject the tested rule.
Only advance after chronological selection-adjusted evaluation and locked-rule forward paper reconciliation. Preserve all previous failed trials.
